# Placet v1.0.0

First public release of the English spec-driven pipeline for Claude Code.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/placethk/placet.git
cd placet
bash install.sh --tools    # Git Bash or WSL on Windows
```

In the **target project** directory:

```text
/placet-init
requirement: I need a user login module
```

## Skills

`/placet-init` · `/placet-knowledge-base` · `/placet-knowledge-base-update` · `/placet-knowledge-fact-gate` · `/placet-status` · `/placet-context-compress` · `/placet-skill-eval` · `/placet-env-setup` · `/placet-ui-ux` · `/placet-now`
